title: WEHIGenomicsRnD/duplex-seq-pipeline pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must start with an ASCII letter or digit and contain only ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

read_structure.errorMessage: Read structure must be one fgbio read structure per read (segments such as 3M, 2S, 146T or +T), separated by a space, e.g. '3M2S146T 3M2S146T'

umi_file.errorMessage: UMI file path cannot contain spaces
